items.title: Elanco Animal Health Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: Elanco Animal Health (NYSE:ELAN) is scheduled to report its earnings on Friday, November 6, 2026. The company has a market value of about $12.6 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $5.0 billion in revenue and $333 million in operating profit, with a net loss of $199 million.

items.title: Moderna Soared 8% on Cancer Data. Friday’s Report Shows Whether It Can Afford the Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna stock jumped 13% on Wednesday to a new 52-week high on early multiple myeloma data and an Ebola vaccine recommendation, then gave back 5% on Thursday ahead of Friday’s report. Pfizer’s Comirnaty sales fell 29% operationally in the third quarter, and BioNTech’s revenue fell 15%.

items.title: Prediction: The Weight-Loss Drug Boom Could Be Just the Beginning for Lilly
items.summary: Eli Lilly just crushed earnings and raised guidance, yet the most compelling part of its story has almost nothing to do with what already happened. The real question is whether the weight-loss boom is a peak or a launching pad for something far bigger.
